Data & privacy

Tide Budget

A personal budgeting app for macOS. Plan monthly spending, track savings goals, and review posted credit card activity.

How card sync works

Tide uses Plaid to read posted transactions from a credit card you choose to connect. You sign in and authorize access through Plaid Link. The connection provides read-only transaction access.

What Tide stores

Tide stores imported transactions in an encrypted database on your Mac and keeps Plaid access tokens in macOS Keychain.

In Card activity, disconnect the card to revoke Tide’s Plaid access. You can then delete imported history from your Mac.
